انهرست (form VII)
# اِنْهَرَسْتُ (inharastu) /in.ha.ras.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
# اِنْهَرَسْتَ (inharasta) /in.ha.ras.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
# اِنْهَرَسْتِ (inharasti) /in.ha.ras.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
# اِنْهَرَسَتْ (inharasat) /in.ha.ra.sat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
